app.name: MedGuard
app.subtitle: Ward Dashboard
nav.label: Main navigation
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.noneHint: New alerts appear here as they happen.
server.banner: Hospital server unreachable. Showing the last data received. Changes are paused until it reconnects.
state.noAccessBody: The admission desk can only use the Queue screens.
state.errorBody: Check the connection, then try again.
dialog.reasonHelp: Required. It is saved in the audit log.
dialog.reasonError: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.
alert.overdue.title: Overdue dose: Bed {bed}
alert.visit.title: Visit seen by camera: Bed {bed}
alert.bedReady.title: Bed {bed} ready
alert.bedReady.detail: Cleaning finished. Bed can be assigned.
alert.request.title: Urgency request: {name}
alert.request.detail: Waiting {hours} h, P2 Urgent. Patient asked to be seen sooner.
alert.fall.title: Fall: Bed {bed}
placeholder.note: This screen is built in step {step}. For now it only proves the route, sidebar and access rules work.
notFound.title: Page not found
screen.D1.title: Login
screen.D1.about: Phone + OTP (test code 123456), then PIN; session locks itself on shared PCs
screen.D2.title: Choose ward
screen.D2.about: For managers covering more than one ward
screen.D3.title: Overview
screen.D3.about: Stat tiles (free beds, open alerts, doses on time %) · bed map by status · live alert feed · staff on duty
screen.D4.title: Camera wall
screen.D4.about: Grid of feeds (2×1, 2×2, 3×3), AI boxes and bed IDs, faces blurred, event markers
screen.D5.title: Single camera
screen.D5.about: One feed large, with its event list (falls, nurse visits) and snapshots
screen.D6.title: Bed board
screen.D6.about: Every bed: status, time in status; filter by status; Mark ready
screen.D7.title: Bed detail
screen.D7.about: Current patient, history, cleaning log, mapped camera
screen.D8.title: Waiting queue
screen.D8.about: Ranked table with urgency request flag · “Why here?” score breakdown · Override with a reason
screen.D9.title: Add to queue
screen.D9.about: Scan Health Profile QR or enter details · priority · source · bed type
screen.D10.title: Urgency requests
screen.D10.about: Patient’s reason · Raise priority or Decline (reason required, patient sees the answer)
screen.D11.title: Assign bed
screen.D11.about: Freed bed matched to the top patient · Confirm or pick another (with a reason) · patient and desk notified
screen.D12.title: Staff on duty
screen.D12.about: Who is in, assigned beds, open tasks, overdue doses per nurse
screen.D13.title: Assign beds to nurses
screen.D13.about: Nurse columns; drag patient cards between them; ratio warning if over limit; Save
screen.D14.title: Shift planner
screen.D14.about: Week grid · AI-proposed plan · rule warnings · drag to change · Publish (with confirm)
screen.D15.title: Swap requests
screen.D15.about: Approve or Decline nurse swaps (decline needs a reason)
screen.D16.title: Incident log
screen.D16.about: Falls and missed doses: time, bed, response time, outcome
screen.D17.title: Incident detail
screen.D17.about: Alarm timeline (sent → escalated → acknowledged → resolved), outcome, notes
screen.D18.title: Dose compliance
screen.D18.about: On-time, late and missed doses by nurse, drug and time of day (bar charts + table)
screen.D19.title: Reports
screen.D19.about: Pilot metrics: bed turnover, doses on time, fall response time · before vs after · Export CSV / PDF
screen.D20.title: Patient directory
screen.D20.about: Search all ward patients → read-only profile (header + allergy strip + summary)
screen.D21.title: Approvals
screen.D21.about: Medicine approvals; only if the manager is also the senior nurse (same as Ward app W34)
login.subtitle: For ward managers and the admission desk.
login.phone.title: Enter your phone number
login.phone.label: Phone number
login.phone.unknown: This number is not registered. Ask your hospital admin to add you.
login.otp.title: Enter the code
login.otp.sent: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {phone}.
login.otp.label: 6-digit code
login.otp.invalid: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
login.pin.title: Enter your PIN
login.pin.body: Your PIN unlocks the dashboard on this shared PC.
login.pin.label: 4-digit PIN
login.server: Hospital server unreachable. Try again when it reconnects.
ward.title: Choose ward
ward.subtitle: {name}, you manage {n} wards. You can switch any time from the top bar.
lock.title: Session locked
lock.idle: Locked after {time} without activity. Enter your PIN to continue where you left off.
lock.manual: Screen locked. Enter your PIN to continue where you left off.
bedmap.title: Bed map
liveFeed.title: Live alerts
staff.title: Staff on duty
beds.subtitle: {ward} · {n} beds
beds.markedToast: Bed {bed} is ready. Assign it from the queue.
bedDetail.cameraBody: {cam} covers beds {range}. It shows bed IDs only, with faces blurred.
bedEvent.oos: Out of service: bed motor broken, repair requested
alert.discharged.title: Bed {bed} discharged
queue.subtitle: {n} waiting · ranked by score
queue.why.request: Urgency request: flagged only, it adds no points.
queue.movedToast: {name} moved up. Saved in the audit log.
queue.moveBody: {name} will be offered the next free bed before {other}. The reason is shown in “Why here?”.
queue.rule: Ranking: emergency level (P1 60, P2 35, P3 10) + 1 point per hour waiting (max 30) + booking order (0–10). An urgency request adds no points; the manager decides.
add.scanBody: Scan the patient’s QR to fill in their details.
add.scanned: Filled from {name}’s Health Profile. Check the details.
add.name: Patient name
add.err.name: Enter the patient’s full name.
add.err.source: Choose where the patient came from.
req.subtitle: Patients ask from their Health Profile app. They see your answer.
req.noneBody: New requests from patients appear here.
req.raisedToast: {name} raised. The patient sees your answer.
req.declinedToast: Request from {name} declined. The patient sees your answer.
req.raiseBody: {name} moves up the queue. Your answer is sent to their Health Profile app.
req.declineBody: {name} keeps their place. Your answer is sent to their Health Profile app.
req.answerHelp: Required. The patient reads this. It is also saved in the audit log.
assign.title: Assign Bed {bed}
assign.notReadyBody: It is “{status}” now. Mark it ready on the Bed board first.
assign.noneBody: No one in the queue needs a general bed.
assign.skippedIcu: {n} ICU patient skipped: this ward has general beds only.
assign.notify: When you confirm, the patient and the admission desk are notified.
assign.otherHelp: Choose a patient. You will need to give a reason.
assign.pickBody: {name} gets the bed instead of {top}, who is top of the queue. The reason is saved in the audit log.
assign.toast: {name} and the admission desk notified. Bed {bed} is reserved.
alert.requestNew.detail: {priority} patient asked to be seen sooner.
camera.offlineHint: The ward team has been alerted. Check the camera cable and power.
camera.sceneLabel: Camera view {cam}. Bed IDs only, faces blurred.
camera.privacyNote: Camera views show bed IDs only, never names. Faces are always blurred.
alert.camOffline.title: {cam} offline
alert.camOffline.detail: Beds {beds} are not being watched by camera. Check on them in person.
staffPage.subtitle: {n} on duty now · rule: 1 nurse for every {max} patients
staffPage.col.name: Name
assignBeds.subtitle: Drag a bed card to another nurse, or use its menu. Rule: 1 nurse for every {max} patients.
assignBeds.unsaved: {n} unsaved change(s). Save to notify the nurses.
assignBeds.help: Moved cards have a blue border until you save. Empty beds can be assigned too, so the nurse is ready when a patient arrives.
shifts.subtitle: Week of {week} · {need} nurses per shift (1 : {ratio}) · at least {rest} h rest
shifts.subtitleEmpty: Plan next week’s shifts. Rules: 1 nurse for every {ratio} patients, at least {rest} h rest between shifts.
shifts.emptyTitle: No plan for next week yet
shifts.emptyBody: Ask the AI for a fair plan, then check it and publish.
shifts.proposedToast: AI plan ready: {n} rule warning(s) to check.
shifts.draftAi: Draft · proposed by AI, not published
shifts.changed: Changed since publishing · publish again to notify nurses
shifts.aiNote: The AI only drafts. Check the plan, fix any warnings, then publish.
shifts.noWarnings: No rule warnings. Every shift is covered and everyone gets enough rest.
shifts.warn.rest: {name}: only {hours} h rest between {from} and {to} (minimum {min} h).
shifts.warn.cover: {shift} {day}: {have} of {need} nurses (1 nurse for every {ratio} patients).
shifts.help: Drag one cell onto another to swap them, or pick from the menu. Morning {m} · Evening {e} · Night {n}.
shifts.publishTitle: Publish the plan for the week of {week}?
shifts.publishBody: {n} nurses will see their shifts in the Ward app (My shifts).
shifts.publishBodyWarn: {n} nurses will see their shifts in the Ward app (My shifts). {w} rule warning(s) are still open.
shifts.noteHelp: Required. Shown with the plan and saved in the audit log.
swaps.subtitle: Nurses ask to trade shifts from the Ward app. They see your answer.
swaps.needPlan: Make a plan first: swaps change next week’s plan.
swaps.approveBody: This swap breaks a rule. Give a reason for approving it anyway.
swaps.declineBody: {from} keeps the shift. Your answer is sent to them in the Ward app.
swaps.answerHelp: Required. The nurse reads this. It is also saved in the audit log.
alert.fallOpen.detail: {patient} · camera saw a fall. Waiting for a nurse to answer.
alarm.falseReason: Why is this a false alarm?
alarm.goingToast: Recorded: you are going to Bed {bed}.
alarm.falseToast: Bed {bed} marked as a false alarm.
incident.subtitle: Falls and missed doses, last 4 weeks
incident.resolvedToast: {id} resolved. Saved in the audit log.
outcome.minorBruise: Minor bruise, treated on the ward
dose.subtitle: On time, late and missed doses, from the Ward app checklist
dose.missedHint: Each one is in the incident log
report.subtitle: Pilot results · {ward} · {date}
report.note: Averages of 4 weeks before and 4 weeks with MedGuard. Bed turnover: discharge to next admission.
